title: Bushfire Risk - Extreme Weather Conditions
summary: Extreme fire danger conditions are forecast for the Blue Mountains region. All campfires and BBQs are prohibited. Visitors are advised to reconsider travel plans.

title: Snow Conditions - Road Closures
summary: Heavy snowfall has caused temporary road closures on Alpine Way and Kosciuszko Road. Chains are required for all vehicles. Check conditions before travel.
source: NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service

title: Track Maintenance - Mackenzie Falls
summary: The Mackenzie Falls walking track will be closed for maintenance from 8am to 4pm daily. Alternative viewing areas remain accessible.

title: High Winds - Tidal River Area
summary: Strong winds up to 60km/h are forecast for the Tidal River area. Campers are advised to secure all equipment and avoid exposed areas.

title: Seasonal Closure - Binna Burra Road
summary: Binna Burra Road will be closed for annual maintenance from 6pm Friday to 6am Monday. Alternative access via O'Reilly's Road.

title: Flood Warning - Daintree River
summary: Heavy rainfall has caused the Daintree River to rise rapidly. Ferry services may be suspended. Do not attempt to cross flooded roads.

title: Shark Alert - Prevelly Beach
summary: A shark has been sighted in the waters off Prevelly Beach. Swimming is not recommended. Beach remains open for other activities.
source: Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development

title: Wildflower Season - Increased Visitors
summary: Peak wildflower season is attracting large numbers of visitors. Expect delays at popular viewing areas and book accommodation in advance.
source: Department of Biodiversity Conservation and Attractions

title: Extreme Heat Warning
summary: Temperatures exceeding 40°C are forecast for the Flinders Ranges. Ensure adequate water supplies and avoid strenuous activities during peak heat.

title: Road Damage - South Coast Road
summary: Recent storms have caused significant damage to South Coast Road. 4WD vehicles only. Check with local authorities before travel.

park_name: Cradle Mountain-Lake St Clair National Park
title: Avalanche Risk - Overland Track
summary: High avalanche risk on the Overland Track due to recent snowfall. Experienced hikers only. Check with Parks Tasmania before departure.

title: Penguin Viewing - Seasonal Restrictions
summary: Little penguin breeding season. Access to viewing areas restricted to guided tours only. Bookings essential.

title: Crocodile Warning - Jim Jim Falls
summary: Saltwater crocodile activity reported near Jim Jim Falls. Swimming is strictly prohibited. Stay well back from water's edge.

title: Cultural Ceremony - Restricted Access
summary: Traditional cultural ceremonies will restrict access to certain areas around Uluru. Respect cultural protocols and follow ranger instructions.

title: Wildlife Research - Temporary Closures
summary: Wildlife research activities will temporarily close some walking tracks in the Orroral Valley area. Alternative routes available.
